title: chore: backfill community app screenshots
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
## Summary

- Adds screenshots to 762 retained community catalog rows.
- Refreshes screenshots for 7 retained community catalog rows.
- Does not remove apps or change other metadata.
- Includes 20 previously missing retained-app covers rechecked in the browser immediately before merge.

## Refreshed screenshots

New screenshot additions are reviewable directly in the catalog diff. Previously
populated screenshot URLs that changed are listed below.

| App | New screenshot URL |
| --- | --- |
| LLM Playground | https://media.pollinations.ai/b89a692b-c90a-445a-9c96-0db3c5b76a53 |
| AI · RPG Engine | https://media.pollinations.ai/93112bb6-9116-4347-8475-33ea8e558a81 |
| AI · RPG Engine | https://media.pollinations.ai/93112bb6-9116-4347-8475-33ea8e558a81 |
| excelformula.pro | https://media.pollinations.ai/76282566-dab5-4719-a6ab-bb8707eb4c0f |
| Strudel AI REPL | https://media.pollinations.ai/3e22c780-e344-498c-bf1d-c82f3df046f2 |
| Convince the CRAZY Idol to let you free | https://media.pollinations.ai/478009e4-a9cd-4895-b5ed-9e14d824cff4 |
| Sirius Cybernetics Elevator Challenge | https://media.pollinations.ai/caf95830-d507-420e-ae02-9b56d3da91ca |

## Validation

- All 20 newly captured media URLs return HTTP 200 with `image/jpeg`.
- The latest commit changes only missing `screenshotUrl` values.
- Catalog row count and all non-screenshot fields are unchanged.

## Merge order

- Merge this screenshot PR first.
- Then refresh #13258 against the resulting `main` before merging the removals.

gist.headline: The app garden got portraits
gist.blurb: 762 community apps now have a proper window into what they do, with seven familiar faces freshly repainted. The catalog remains the same garden; it is simply much easier to wander through.
gist.summary: Backfilled screenshot URLs for 762 retained community catalog apps and refreshed screenshots for 7 existing entries, without changing app metadata or catalog row count.
gist.impact: Visitors browsing the community catalog now get visual previews for hundreds more apps, including 20 covers rechecked in-browser immediately before merge.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the community app catalog as a cozy greenhouse gallery: rows of small framed app screenshots bloom like flower displays, while Polli carefully hangs a new picture frame and admiringly checks the garden. A CRT monitor robot can hold a tiny catalog card or frame, emphasizing that many apps are now visible at a glance.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art greenhouse gallery filled with rows of tiny framed community app screenshots growing among flowers and code-plants, with lime green (#ecf874) prominently glowing from the catalog display wall. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny curator beret while hanging a new screenshot frame as a cute CRT monitor robot holds another frame. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, subtle pixel-font text: 'APP GARDEN', nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
